name: Medela Potentia Tbk.
summary: PT Medela Potentia Tbk produces and distributes a wide range of pharmaceutical and healthcare products throughout Indonesia and Cambodia. Its offerings include medical devices, spanning from consumable supplies to specialized equipment for hospitals and laboratories. The company also operates the GoApotik.com digital platform, an online channel that makes its products available to retailers, direct consumers, and patients. Founded in 2011, the firm is headquartered in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia.
